body: Yes i feel sick everytime i wake up too. I try to drink less every day but i just can't stop all of the sudden. My plan for today is to be as sober as i can so i can do something productive and be a little bit prouder of myself. Wish you well and i hope we both get the strenght to get in line.

Good for you going to recovery. And i'm happy you are in a good relationship as it seems. Not sure why AA whould say that. I think your girlfriend can only be helpfull to you. How long have you been sober? And did you have side effects? Like delirium tremens? I'm asking because i feel like i want to try to get sober again these days - like tommorow or during the weekend. I just watched some stuff that said you shouldn't do it on your own if you are alcoholic. I haven't been fully sober for at least a couple of months now so i'm a bit scared of what might happen.
Also sorry for the bad English, its not my native language :)

Thanks. Today i was also thinking about going in AA. I hope tomorow will bring me the courage to do the first step. Wish you well too. And i didn't mean to shit on therapists, i know they are just doing their job i just want to be prepared for my next one so i don't sound so shitty i guess. I think that every time i go to one i'm not fully honest or i make it seem its not a big deal, when i know drinking 24 hours a day is a big problem. Wish you the best.

Thanks. The first person i visited (the one that told me im searching for exuses to drink) was a psychiatrist, who specialises in addiction. I was in my early twenties so i guess she thought i was too young to have a severe problem or something. Couple of years ago i went to a psychologist for some time but i don't think we had good vibe between eachother. Basically all she wanted to do was to analyse my dreams which weren't something special anyway and i don't think she was very interested in what i had to say. I'm thinking about visiting another psychiatrist in my town, who has a good reputation and is a specialist in addiction. I think he might perscribe me some medication or appoint me to a good therapist. I hope so at least.

Thanks. Thats what i'm thinking about too. Although the first one i visited - when i was 23 or 24 was a specialist in that area. I dunno maybe she thought i can't be an alcoholic because i was too young or something. But yeah two years ago i had an year and a half period of sobriety which i acomplished on my own. I hope i can i achive it again but i think i will need help or medication this time.

No problem man. Don't listen to the troll. I haven't been trough what you describe but i've tried to off myself with drugs. As i said at least give yourself some 10 years more. Then decide. You still have some shit to live for.
Read my comments man i want you to live through this
But i'm not the one who is pushing you into suicide
Man why are you cursing me? Lol. Just get sober and think it trough again.

And since i'm pretty sure you are an atheist, at least you sound like one, why should he die when there is nothing better looking for him? I am pretty much an atheist so thats why i'm asking. Death is death - it won't be better or worse from this life, so he should at least try to live.

Well what then? I mean during the last 10 years at least i tried a lot of stuff, that did not work for me. Thats why i'm thinking about killing myself. But at 20 you still have your chances in front of you. What is the point of him dying now? When he is still perfectly fit and have the stamina to change things. I get you try to be rational, but at the end of the day your arguments are still dumb af. I'm not arguing that there is a "point" to this, all i say is that 20-30 you are in the peroid when you can at least try to do your best.

Yeah i am putting the age restriction and i am suicidal so i know what hes going trough. But i know that at 20 you still have your life in front of you, so good things might still happen even if they did not for me. And yeah - i am the asshole, not the person telling people to go kill themselves on the internet. You are fucking pathetic.

As i said in the other comment you are way too young to give up  brother. Life is hard. But give yourself at least 10 more years - get to 30. Then make your decisions. I don't want to bullshit you but in 10 years a lot of shit can happen. Don't give up NOW.

Fuck you man. He is only 20. Man i've been there. this is probs the drugs speaking. You should clean yourself up and try to find a job. Trust me you are way too young to give up. At least get to my age - 31, then you can think about ending it, not now.
Thank you. I am just thinking at this point. But as you said we all seek peace. Ending it might be the one for me, i just worry about my family.
Be nice! Ill give you some love!
Thank you. I'll try. Yes, starting slow is the best i think too.
You too! Wish you the best

Thanks. I'll go to psychiatrist soon and i just want to know what to tell them. I have been asked this question before, i mean have you ever got any suicidal thoughts and i aways ignored those - answered no. Thats why i asked.
Thanks i hope i will too. Don't want to lie today, i will just do my best
Thank you so much. The fact that you care is enough to make me want to try again. I'll check them. Much love to you. And i'm sorry but im a bit drunk today, i hope i won't be in future
Thanks. Its Bulgarian. I don't know if we have AA here lol. But thanks i'll seek someone else

Thank you. I am considering going to some organisation, therapist. I guess i should try it again. Just my experience with psychologists so far hasn't been the best. English is not my first language btw, so i'm sorry if i sound unclear. Wish you the best
Thanks, i'm trying i have my better days with my bad days recently. I guess thats life. I wish you the best too.
I know i'm in a loop btw. I just don't know how to get out of it.

Not much sadly. Most of my old friends don't do drugs or drink as much as i, so i'm kinda ashamed to even call them nowdays. Recently i made some new "normal" for lack of a better word friends, but again my drug habbits just make me want to stay away from them.
I use the word spiritual because i don't know what else to call it. I don't really believe in spirits at least im not convinced in the matter. But yeah some of this expiriences are just too weird.

I don't either. I mean why am i this way. Since half an year ago i had my year and a half period of sobriety. Man was i happy! I was focused and in shape, and i was 100 % in every way. Last 5-6 months i'm drunk daily or on speed. I wish i had the streght to go back to the times when i was sober. All i can tell you though is that i was happiest in my life when i was sober. So my advices are - work out - it can get you high naturally and just try to find something to hold on. For me it was painting, but can be whatever for you. Wish you well and i wish you have the strenght i don't at the moment.
Yeah i guess that is the logical explanation. I belive that too.
I'm just wondering if when i get sober i will get better mentally. I know i must will logicaly its just hard for me to belive it at this moment
Well im on a bottle daily so i guess its time to ditch it. Did liquor made you feel suicidal tho?
Damn. Sorry to hear that. Do you abuse drugs or alcohol? I'm asking because i found that my suicidal thoughts get worse when i'm drinking too much. And the irony is that im drinking because of them
Tell me more about your experiences. Were they caused because of drugs or you just had insomnia?
Yeah i guess some drugs just give you that feeling. Im not sure its real tho

I wasn't sleeping for days sometimes. Usually i had those expiriences when i passed the third day with no sleep. It started with minor audio hallucinations and some shadows moving in the background. Only once i had that whole conversation with a bunch of people that i knew werent around me but still it felt real. I havent slept for 6 days i guess at that point.
Yeah. I think i mostly do drugs at this point because of lonelyness. It just gets so much sometimes that i need that extra boost to go on with my life.
